value: When the preparations had brought the campaign to the Scarab Wall, the restored scepter could be raised against the gong. The barrier made by the ancient defenders opened, and the danger it had contained came forth. The ensuing struggle was remembered as the Ten-Hour War. The relic's recovery had not ended the conflict; it had made the confrontation possible. Where Fandral once turned away from the gate in grief, a later generation now stood together before the consequences of opening it.
